headline: EPS surges q/q and grows year-over-year
summary_short: Kansai Electric Power reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥123.02, up 244.0% q/q and 38.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥123.02 more than tripled sequentially from ¥35.77 (+244.0%) and rose 38.2% year-over-year from ¥89.01. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
